explanation_zh: 训练代码先在MPS算B@A，再转CPU并用FP32 norm汇总。保存参数在CPU复算FP32乘积及FP32 norm，可逐项复现24个值；对同一个CPU FP32乘积只改用FP64 norm，结果便接近FP64乘积及trace恒等式。差异可由CPU FP32 norm归约精度解释，不能据此归咎MPS权重错误。原oracle比较的18个超容差事实保留，不放宽阈值，不改变科学指标。
precision_boundary: This reproduces reported scalar norms and establishes a CPU arithmetic explanation; saved MPS product matrices were not independently compared elementwise, and no GPU was run.
v2_scope: Only Q/V reported-norm reproduction uses matching CPU FP32 definition with additional exact equality; FP64 oracle values retained. Every primary metric, bootstrap setting, B norm predicate and other check unchanged.
